zh.title: 加拿大皇家空軍接收首架空中巴士H135
zh.summary: 加拿大皇家空軍接收首架空中巴士H135，命名為CT-153 Juno準備展開訓練。
body: 加拿大皇家空軍已接收其空中巴士H135直升機機隊的首架飛機。該款直升機在加拿大軍方內部被命名為CT-153 Juno，標誌著加拿大國家航空訓練計畫邁入全新的重要里程碑。
在順利完成首架CT-153 Juno直升機的交付作業後，加拿大皇家空軍正積極開展各項相關的訓練準備工作，為後續軍用航空人員培訓做好周全整備。
根據過往公開的營運紀錄，空中巴士在2026年第二季期間共計交付237架飛機，並持續維持全年交付870架飛機的目標。

en.title: Royal Canadian Air Force Receives First Airbus H135 Helicopter
en.summary: The Royal Canadian Air Force received its first Airbus H135 helicopter, designated CT-153 Juno, for training operations.
body: The Royal Canadian Air Force has taken delivery of the first helicopter in its new Airbus H135 fleet. Officially designated as the CT-153 Juno, the aircraft represents a significant operational milestone for Canada's military pilot training capabilities.

Following the arrival of the first CT-153 Juno helicopter, the Royal Canadian Air Force is actively preparing for upcoming crew training and technical readiness operations to support the new aircraft fleet.
According to verified historical records, Airbus delivered 237 aircraft during the second quarter of 2026 and continues working to meet its full-year target of 870 total aircraft deliveries.
